claim: Gu, Kelly and Xiu (RFS 2020): monthly out-of-sample R2 of individual US stock returns is 0.34% for gradient-boosted trees, 0.33% for random forests, 0.33% for NN1 and 0.40% at most for NN3; PCR 0.26%, elastic net 0.11%; all methods agree on a small set of dominant price-trend signals.
quote: all methods agree on a fairly small set of dominant predictive signals
limitations: Full-text via r.jina.ai; tuned models, 920 features incl. fundamentals and macro; no transaction costs; sample ends 2016.
independent_replication: Avramov-Cheng-Metzker 2023 and Chen-Pelger-Zhu 2024 extend it; none tests these six families under a small-cap, cost-aware, 2016-2023 walk-forward.
impact_on_spec: Sets the prior that model-family differences among nonlinear models are small (RankIC moves under 0.005); supports the NN3 shape and the 0.010 material-effect threshold.

claim: Avramov, Cheng and Metzker (Management Science 2023): deep-learning signal profits come from difficult-to-arbitrage stocks and high limits-to-arbitrage states; excluding microcaps, distressed stocks or high-volatility episodes attenuates them, and reasonable trading costs deteriorate them further because of high turnover.
quote: excluding microcaps, distressed stocks, or episodes of high market volatility considerably attenuates profitability
limitations: Abstract page only (SSRN full text needs a human check); no full replication.
independent_replication: Consistent with T-20260928-30, where fixed 10 bp did not pass; no independent replication found.
impact_on_spec: Explains why stage 2 uses fixed 10/20 bp costs and why liquidity terciles are reported.

claim: Grinsztajn, Oyallon and Varoquaux (NeurIPS D&B 2022): on 45 medium-sized tabular datasets tree-based models (XGBoost, random forests) remain state-of-the-art, including after tuning; neural networks are hurt by uninformative features and non-rotation-invariance.
limitations: Not a financial return panel; abstract page snapshot.
independent_replication: Widely reproduced; not tested on cross-sectional return ranks.
impact_on_spec: Prior that the MLP cell will not beat the tree families; MLP kept because GKX report NN3 as best.

claim: Chen, Pelger and Zhu (Management Science 2024): a deep neural network with a no-arbitrage criterion, adversarial test assets and macro states outperforms benchmarks out of sample in Sharpe, explained variation and pricing errors.
quote: outperforms out-of-sample all benchmark approaches in terms of Sharpe ratio
limitations: Needs macro states and a different objective (SDF), not a pure ranking regression; arXiv abstract page; no trading costs.
independent_replication: Avramov et al. 2023 report the gains shrink outside difficult-to-arbitrage names.
impact_on_spec: Shows that the objective, not only the family, could matter; not tested here (grid stays regression on excess return rank).

claim: LightGBM documents min_data_in_leaf, feature_fraction and bagging parameters used by the B0 parameter set (kt.LGBM_REG_PARAMS) and native missing-value handling.
limitations: Documentation only; says nothing on financial data.
impact_on_spec: Grid uses kt.LGBM_REG_PARAMS unchanged (B0 reproduction cell).

claim: XGBoost documents tree_method=hist, max_depth, learning_rate, subsample, colsample_bytree, min_child_weight and reg_lambda used in the XGB grid cell; missing values are handled natively.
impact_on_spec: Fixes the XGB parameter names used in the preregistered grid.

claim: CatBoostRegressor documents depth, learning_rate, iterations, loss_function, rsm, bootstrap_type, subsample and min_data_in_leaf used in the CAT grid cell; native missing-value handling.
limitations: Snapshot of a JS-rendered page; only the static text is captured; min_data_in_leaf applies to lossguide/depthwise growth in the docs, so the setting may be inert under the default symmetric tree.
impact_on_spec: Fixes the CAT parameter names in the grid; hyperparameters are not tuned.

claim: scikit-learn MLPRegressor documents hidden_layer_sizes, activation, alpha, learning_rate_init, batch_size, max_iter, early_stopping, validation_fraction and n_iter_no_change used in the MLP grid cell; no native missing-value handling.
limitations: Documentation only; not the GKX ensemble with batch normalisation.
impact_on_spec: Fixes the MLP parameter names; NaN ranks are filled with 0.5 before fitting.
